answer: Put dental arch scan commitment per account at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 629 aliases would need 629 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The lagoon sits in the mechanism itself, the bridge sits in the price of faking it, and the pearl sits in the record no template can forge. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
